topic: How does the hierarchical classification framework impact satellite link budget margins when prioritizing QoS-sensitive traffic?
consensus_response: Hierarchical classification frameworks prioritize QoS-sensitive traffic, optimizing resource allocation and reducing interference. Integrating advanced techniques like ACM, beamforming, and MIMO enhances spectral efficiency and reliability. NGSO constellations further reduce latency, improving link margins and QoS guarantees for critical applications.
reference_context: QoS-OSPF and MPLS approaches focus on capacity management, neglecting latency and jitter, while hierarchical frameworks prioritize traffic, optimizing satellite link budgets.
